mapper.select: SELECT parent.run_id FROM agent_runtime_execution_runs parent JOIN agent_runtime_execution_waits waiting ON waiting.tenant_id=parent.tenant_id AND waiting.run_id=parent.run_id AND waiting.action_id=parent.waiting_action_id AND waiting.generation=parent.waiting_generation JOIN agent_runtime_executions execution ON execution.tenant_id=waiting.tenant_id AND execution.execution_id=waiting.execution_id WHERE parent.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND parent.phase='WAITING' AND NOT parent.cancelled AND waiting.kind='WORKFLOW' AND waiting.input_id IS NULL AND execution.state='WAITING_EXTERNAL' AND execution.cancel_request_id IS NULL AND execution.execution_revision=waiting.execution_revision AND execution.waiting_suspend_ref=waiting.suspend_ref AND execution.waiting_action_key=waiting.action_key ORDER BY parent.run_id LIMIT #{limit}
